newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0800 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.150 to up 0.100 cent. Carryover likely on slow cash markets but could be oversold.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Jump in index should turn price back higher despite higher corn calls.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Storm reduced hog runs and higher cash indications. But packer demand light.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Carryover demand on light kill pace should offset weak tone to cash.
